SELECT u.uuid as uid,u.nickname,u.username,left(u.signature,100) as signature,u.avatar, u.title_name,u.title_color, (SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT pid ) FROM user_acproblem WHERE uid = u.uuid) AS ac, (SELECT COUNT(uid) FROM judge WHERE uid=u.uuid AND cid=0 AND gid is null) AS total FROM user_info u
u.status = 0
AND u.uuid in
#{uid}
ORDER BY ac DESC,total ASC

SELECT u.uuid as uid,u.nickname,u.username,u.avatar,u.title_name,u.title_color, COUNT(recent.pid) AS ac FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT uid,pid FROM judge WHERE status = 0 AND cid = 0 AND gid IS NULL GROUP BY uid,pid HAVING MIN(gmt_create) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 6 DAY) ) recent ON recent.uid = u.uuid WHERE u.status = 0 GROUP BY u.uuid,u.nickname,u.username,u.avatar,u.title_name,u.title_color,u.gmt_create ORDER BY ac DESC,u.gmt_create DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT points FROM oj_problem_points WHERE uid=#{uid} AND gid IS NULL AND completion_ratio>0

SELECT CASE WHEN p.auth=1 THEN p.problem_id ELSE NULL END AS problem_id, CASE WHEN p.auth=1 THEN p.title ELSE '受限题目' END AS title, COALESCE(d.display_text,'未配置难度') AS difficulty, s.base_points,s.completion_ratio,s.points,s.estimated FROM oj_problem_points s JOIN problem p ON p.id=s.pid LEFT JOIN problem_difficulty_config d ON d.difficulty_value=p.difficulty WHERE s.uid=#{uid} AND s.gid IS NULL AND s.completion_ratio>0 ORDER BY s.points DESC,s.pid ASC

SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT ui.uuid AS uid, ui.nickname, ui.username, ui.avatar, ui.title_name,ui.title_color , ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) FROM judge WHERE uid = ui.uuid and cid=0 and gid = #{gid} and status = 0 ) AS ac , ( SELECT COUNT(uid) FROM judge WHERE uid = ui.uuid and cid=0 and gid = #{gid} ) AS total, COALESCE(ss.score,0) AS score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ss.score,0) DESC, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) FROM judge WHERE uid=ui.uuid AND cid=0 AND gid=#{gid} AND status=0) DESC) AS rank_position FROM user_info ui right join ( SELECT u.uuid AS uid, COALESCE(SUM(s.score),0) AS score FROM user_info u left join ( SELECT points AS score, uid, pid FROM oj_problem_points WHERE gid = #{gid} ) s ON s.uid = u.uuid
u.status = 0
AND u.uuid in
#{uid}
GROUP BY u.uuid ) ss on ss.uid = ui.uuid ) ranked
WHERE ranked.uid in
#{uid}
ORDER BY ranked.ac DESC, ranked.total ASC, ranked.uid ASC
ORDER BY ranked.rank_position ASC, ranked.uid ASC
